subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo / Redwood intro

Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo / Redwood intro

Thanks again for taking time today, Daniel — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for personalized notifications and cut per-token cost on low-latency endpoints.
- Key stakeholders: Priya (Integrations), Michael (CTO) — want to see architecture and integration options.
- Success criteria: <20ms p50 on 1k qps burst, deterministic routing to cheaper variants, and SOC 2 evidence for vendor selection.

Next step: 30-min product demo / intro where we can show a focused flow (integration options + expected perf/cost). Please pick one of these 30-min slots and who from your side will join: 
- Tue Feb 17, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Wed Feb 18, 2026 — 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Thu Feb 19, 2026 — 11:00–11:30 AM PST

Agenda (attached): 1) 10-min tailored demo, 2) 10-min integration & deployment Qs, 3) 10-min next steps / procurement checklist.

Attaching the short agenda and SOC2 summary to help with procurement questions. Looping in Marissa (SE) to lead the demo.

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: 20260214-demo-agenda.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the recap. Wed Feb 18, 2:00–2:30 PM PST works best for us. Priya (Integrations) and Michael (CTO) will join.

A couple quick asks so we can prepare on our side:
- Can you include a short section on how Redwood integrates with our KMS and data residency options?
- We’ll likely need to review SOC 2 artifacts with our security team — is the summary you attached good enough to start? If not, can you share the evidence pack or a link?

Please send a calendar invite and any prep notes. Looking forward to the demo.

—Daniel
